about: Breaches on main when the clip check was built (2026-11-01), each in a defect group with an owner. Shrink-only (LAWS.md law 5): clipcheck fails when an entry no longer shows up (delete it), and tools/perf/knowncheck.mjs fails when an entry is added. Groups are ranked by how visible they are on a phone (G1 most).
